economic_inheritance.source: The exact C256 contract bytes identified above are the sole economic specification. C257 adds no alternative parameter, diagnostic promotion path or economic overlay.
economic_inheritance.exact_rule: Every value in every unchanged section is inherited byte-semantically from the exact C256 contract. Signal, thresholds, side construction, pairing, execution, risk, costs, split boundaries, gates, multiplicity and PAPER terms may not change.
economic_inheritance.multiplicity_rule: Retain C256's already-frozen 0.05/256 ceiling unchanged; C257 may not use its new number to relax that gate.
economic_inheritance.identity_rule: candidate_id=257 is an audit-ledger identity only. It does not alter inherited economics or revive C256.
economic_inheritance.no_c256_rescue: C256 remains terminally DATA-INCOMPLETE. No C256 outcome may be created, inspected, inferred or used to select, tune, reject or rescue C257.

authority_v6.mechanical_amendment_rule: After all four authority-v6 outputs and their builder are independently reviewed and protected-merged, one amendment may replace only protected_authority_head, the four null output_pins, and status. Each pin must contain the plan-declared path plus exact byte_sha256 and content_digest from protected bytes. Any other change creates a new numbered family.

evaluation_preconditions: all four authority-v6 output pins are non-null and exact
the authority builder and exact output bytes are on protected master
the mechanical pin amendment receives independent review
a separately byte-bound evaluator and adapter receive independent review
the candidate remains default-OFF until independent out-of-sample evidence passes
